title: Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation for Reinforcement Learning of Skill-Based LLM Agents
title_zh: 面向技能型 LLM Agent 强化学习的双向上下文自蒸馏
abstract_en: External natural-language skills provide large language model (LLM) agents with reusable and editable guidance for solving complex tasks. Yet their effectiveness depends not only on skill quality, but also on whether the policy can translate the provided guidance into appropriate actions. However, methods specifically designed to improve this skill-utilization ability remain largely underexplored. In practice, skill-based agents are commonly trained with reinforcement learning objectives centered on task-level rewards, which offer limited supervision and struggle to capture subtle differences in how effectively the policy uses the provided skills. We propose BCSD (Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation), a framework that combines self-distillation with reinforcement learning to train LLM agents to use external skills more effectively. Unlike prior self-distillation methods that rely on a single privileged context, BCSD evaluates each trajectory from two complementary skill-context views. The augmented view introduces higher-level Meta-Skill guidance, while the reduced view prunes general guidance to highlight task-specific skills. Their complementary token-level signals are combined to rescale the RL advantage. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that BCSD achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales, enabling agents to utilize external skills more effectively. Ablation studies further verify the complementary contributions of the augmented and reduced context views. Code will be released to ensure full reproducibility.
abstract_zh: 外部自然语言技能（external natural-language skills）能为 LLM Agent 提供可复用、可编辑的任务指导，但其效果不仅取决于技能本身质量，也取决于策略模型能否将这些指导转化为正确行动。现有技能型 Agent 通常依赖任务级奖励进行强化学习训练，监督信号稀疏，难以刻画模型对技能利用程度的细微差异。本文提出 BCSD（Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation），将自蒸馏与强化学习结合，以提升 LLM Agent 对外部技能的利用能力。不同于依赖单一特权上下文的自蒸馏方法，BCSD 从两个互补的技能上下文视角评估同一轨迹：增强视角引入更高层的 Meta-Skill 指导，缩减视角则裁剪通用指导以突出任务特定技能。两类视角产生的 token-level 信号被合并后用于重新缩放 RL advantage，从而为策略优化提供更细粒度的技能利用反馈。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明，BCSD 在不同模型规模下取得最强整体表现，并能更有效地促进 Agent 使用外部技能；消融实验也验证了增强与缩减上下文视角的互补作用。
key_points_zh: 提出 BCSD，将 self-distillation 与 reinforcement learning 结合，专门优化技能型 LLM Agent 对外部自然语言技能的利用能力。
设计双向上下文视角：augmented view 通过 Meta-Skill 提供高层指导，reduced view 通过裁剪通用信息突出任务特定技能。
利用两个视角产生的互补 token-level 信号重新缩放 RL advantage，相比仅依赖任务级奖励提供更细粒度的训练监督。
在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 实验中，BCSD 在不同模型规模下取得最强整体性能，表明其能提升复杂交互任务中的技能使用效果。
消融实验显示 augmented view 与 reduced view 均有贡献，二者结合能带来互补增益。

llm_assessment.comment: BCSD fits well as an agent-training method for improving skill utilization through RL signals derived from complementary skill-context views.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: BCSD作为提升技能利用能力的智能体训练方法契合度较高，它通过互补技能上下文视角改进强化学习信号。
